policy_config.selector: round-robin LexRank sentences, centrality within a turn
policy_config.similarity: tf-idf cosine, idf over the conversation's sentences
policy_config.comparable_to: leadk/tailk at the same fraction: identical budget, breadth and round-robin, differing only in which sentence of a turn is kept.

survival.primary_subset: golds with >= 2 normalized tokens; one-token golds are excluded from the headline because their chance floor is high enough to dominate the rate
